changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 4 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6310-designer-formula-key-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `designer.field.formula` (`'Formula (CEL)'`) in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, a different and live key belonging to metadata-admin's `ObjectFieldInspector` — the surface that still authors formula expressions.

### `.changeset/7125-dashboard-empty-state-keys-retired.md`

- names `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Not touched: `table.noRows` (`'No rows to display'`) and `engine.form.noRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, read at `widgets.tsx`) — two different, same-named keys in different namespaces. Nor the comments in `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`, `ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `PivotTable.tsx` that record WHY three widgets with three strings became one shared empty state; the packs' own comment keeps that rationale and now names the retirement instead of a row that is gone.

### `.changeset/8632-malformed-picklist-option-loud.md`

- names `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` — edited by this change

  > Two new strings land in the designer's own `en` / `zh` tables — the metadata-admin console owns its strings in `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` and is deliberately outside the ten locale packs (`packages/i18n/README.md`, "Scope — the `engine.*` carve-out").

### `.changeset/9952-condition-placeholder-derives-from-offered-roots.md`

- names `conditionScope.ts` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/conditionScope.ts` — edited by this change

  > The placeholder was a string literal — `record.status != 'done' && user.isAdmin` — handed to `CelPredicateField` at **every** mount, `scope` or no `scope`. The same component had already narrowed a record-scoped mount's autocomplete to `RECORD_CONDITION_ROOTS` (objectui#9645), which carries no `user`, and narrowed that mount's subject dropdown the same way (objectui#9855). At such a mount `user` is not merely unadvertised: `conditionScope.ts` states that a hook `condition` and a validation rule's guard are evaluated with `{ record, previous }` and only those, fail-CLOSED at the validation host, and objectstack's `wrapDeclarativeHook` docblock says the condition formula is evaluated against two bindings, `record` and `previous`. So the one line an author reads before typing anything taught a root the evaluator never binds, and copying it cost the author the write.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `cb2f6fb5b` (merge-base with origin/main): 10 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1824 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2434 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36748509075)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `49a07a8a961f8fedf24ad590988d2d2c0e93607a`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #10188 (body and all six comments — the director's addendum `5754645580`, the claim `5912572371`, the dev report `5915968413`), PR #11241 (body, the 11-file list, the net diff against `main` at the merge-base `dded788ada`: +1200/−1 over those 11 files and nothing else), the head's 42 check-runs, and the installed spec at the `@objectstack/spec@17.5.0` tag commit (`packages/spec/src/system/doc.zod.ts`, `book.zod.ts`, `system/index.ts`, `package.json`) for every spec claim.

### ① Derived judgments

Accept-set — what the editor writes, against `DocSchema` at 17.5.0, a `strictObject` declaring `name`, `label`, `description`, `content`, `order`, `group`, `tags`, `translations` plus the protection envelope, with `title` a refused alias of `label` and `locale`/`locales` of `translations`:

- `previews/doc-draft.ts` patches write `content` (the base body), `translations[tag]` as `{ label?, description?, content }` (variant body, title, summary; add; remove) and `group` (the picker) — nothing else. Removing the last variant yields `translations: undefined`, a declared optional key; an emptied variant `label`/`description` is deleted, not stored as an empty string. **Right**, and the entry shape is the spec's `DocTranslation` exactly.
- Create form (`default-schemas.ts`): `createFields: ['label','name','description']`, `createDerive` slugify from `label` to `name`, `createDefaults: { content: '' }` — `content` is the one required key besides `name`, and `''` parses. The card's "title" / "locale" mapped to `label` / `translations`: **right** — the card's words are not spec keys, the alias table refuses them, and the page suite replays the measured 17.5.0 `422 INVALID_METADATA` refusal of `title`.
- No second metadata-editing path: `DocPreview` is registered through `registerMetadataPreview('doc', …)` in `previews/index.ts`; `ResourceEditPage.tsx` changes by two lines — `doc` joins `CREATE_MODE_CANVAS_TYPES`, and `CANVAS_OWNED_KEYS.doc = ['content','translations','group']` — so the canvas patches the same draft the Save button sends (`onPatch` merges into `handleDraftChange`), the properties form hides those three keys, and the one write is `client.save('doc', name, body, { mode: 'draft' })`. No new route, page, client or write door. **Right**; `ResourceEditPage.docEditor-10188.test.tsx` pins the body `{ name, label, content, group }` and `DocSchema.safeParse` on it.
- Book placement: `BookSchema` at the tag stores `groups` only — no members — and `resolveBookTree` places a doc in the first group whose `include` matches OR whose `key` equals `doc.group`. Placement is therefore the doc-side `group` write, and the claim's "book overlay" premise is falsified as the dev reports: no book write exists or is added. **Right.**
- Read-back: `resolvePlacements` runs the spec's own `resolveBookTree(spine, [doc], packageId)` per listed book and keeps the first `spine.groups.length` groups. The resolver emits exactly one group per spine group and appends `uncategorized` only after them, so cutting by position is exact and mirrors `resolveBookClaimedDocs`' exclusion. It reports a rule placement with no `group`, every book sharing the key, a `public` audience, an unknown key kept visible, and a list failure as a failure rather than "no books". **Right and honest** about what it computes: the spec's own docblock says `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` answers `resolveBookTree()` verbatim, and the README ties the readout to that endpoint.
- What the portal does NOT do: the dev measured the portal sidebar not listing the placed env-wide doc; the seam is `apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts` `scopeDocsToBook`, which drops docs outside the book's packages before resolving (read at the head; consistent with the finding). Nothing in this diff claims the sidebar: the PR body discloses the gap, the README names the tree endpoint, and the `engine.docPreview.unplaced` string ("book trees list it under Uncategorized") is the resolver's documented orphan rule. The changeset's "shows where the doc will appear, computed with the spec's `resolveBookTree`" is true of the resolver and the tree endpoint and not yet of the portal sidebar for an env-wide doc; it is qualified in the same sentence — **right**, residual noted in ③ B.
- Preview: `SchemaRenderer schema={{ type: 'markdown', content }}` from `@object-ui/react`, an existing dependency. `apps/console/src/pages/DocPage.tsx:225` renders the portal page with the same `{ type: 'markdown', content }`, and `register-plugins.ts:116` registers `markdown` lazily from `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`. `packages/app-shell/package.json` is not in the diff: no new dependency, not even a dev one. The README's "unknown-component notice" is `SchemaRenderer.tsx`'s "Unknown component type" panel. **Right.**
- `conditionScope.ts` row `doc: 'none'`: `ConditionWidget.conditionScope.test.tsx` enumerates `listMetadataResources()` and reddens on a registered type without a row; `default-schemas.ts` newly registers `doc`, and `DocSchema` declares no `visible` / `hidden` / `disabled` / `condition` / `*When` key, so `none` is the ruling's own last row (a type without a row of its own), not a re-opened verdict. **Right.**
- `default-schemas.ts` registers create hints only and no fallback schema — the server serves `DocSchema`'s JSON Schema on `/meta/types`, and a copy here could only drift. `MetadataResourceConfig` makes `schema`, `label` and `domain` optional, and `createConformance.test.ts` covers a type without a client schema as "shape only". **Right.**
- i18n: 26 `engine.docPreview.*` keys and the `doc` type label ("Documentation" / "文档") in both the `en` and `zh` tables of `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, beside the `engine.bookPreview.*` keys already there; no `packages/i18n` pack touched. **Right** (Zone 3 route, ③ item 2).
- Public surface: `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is untouched and re-exports nothing from `previews/`, `conditionScope.ts`, `default-schemas.ts` or `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (grep at the head: no hit). The only observable additions are runtime registry entries — `getMetadataPreview('doc')`, `listMetadataPreviewTypes()` and `listMetadataResources()` now include `doc` — additive behaviour with no exported symbol, type or schema change. **Right.**

Check-runs on the head (read 2026-09-30T17:11Z): 32 `success` (among them Type Check, Lint, Build & E2E, Bundle Analysis, README Export Check, Changeset Declaration / Bump Policy / Fixed Group Check / Claim Re-read, Test (dist pins), Test shards 4/8 and 8/8, Docs Route Eager Closure Check, Governed Surface Queue Guard), 3 `skipped` (Test (coverage), Test (coverage shard), dependabot), and 7 `in_progress`, each NOT yet concluded and read as neither pass nor fail: Spec Main Shape Gate, Test (shard 1/8), Test (shard 2/8), Test (shard 3/8), Test (shard 5/8), Test (shard 6/8), Test (shard 7/8).

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10188-doc-markdown-editor.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': minor`. The diff touches one released package (`check-changeset-presence`: 9 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset; Changeset Declaration, Bump Policy and Fixed Group Check green on the head). A new feature — a registered `doc` preview and resource row, new strings — with no removed or changed export, prop type or schema: **minor is right**.

Changeset body against the diff, line by line: the title line — delivered; "a Markdown source pane beside a live preview, rendered by the same `markdown` renderer the docs portal uses" — delivered (`DocPage.tsx:225`); "Before, the generic form offered the body as a one-line text input with no preview" — the dev's measured premise 1, not contradicted by anything in the diff; "writes only keys `DocSchema` declares, and saves through the standard metadata write door (`PUT /meta/doc/:name`)" — pinned by both suites; "Title and body" — `createFields`, slugify, `content` on the canvas; "Locale variants … starts as a copy of the default body" — `patchAddLocale`; "Book placement … its own `group` key … every book that uses the key is listed, and a public book is marked" — `resolvePlacements`; "shows where the doc will appear, computed with the spec's `resolveBookTree`" — true of the resolver and the tree endpoint, see ③ B; "a label for the `doc` type in English and Chinese" — delivered. README section, line by line: the create-mode canvas through the generic edit page and `PUT /meta/doc/:name` — delivered; registry `markdown` with no plugin dependency and the unknown-component notice — delivered; `translations` with no `locale` key and the seeded variant — delivered; the `group` write with the readout tied to `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` — delivered; `CANVAS_OWNED_KEYS` and `previews/doc-draft.ts` — delivered. Neither text claims the menu, the portal sidebar or the acceptance item.

`Clause-②: no` — **holds**: no `@object-ui/app-shell` export, published type, prop type or schema changes accept or reject; `index.ts` and `package.json` are outside the diff. No declaration re-read is owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (PR body and report), each answered:

1. `packages/app-shell/README.md` outside the claim's file surface — **accepted**: the package's own README for a feature in that package, declared in the PR body; README Export Check green.
2. New strings in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, not in `packages/i18n` packs — **accepted**: the designer's `engine.*` tables are where the neighbouring `engine.bookPreview.*` strings live; the zh-CN leak test pins no untranslated key.
3. The heading / list / link render pin carried by `@object-ui/plugin-markdown`'s `markdown-render.test.tsx` plus the live reading, while the app-shell suites stub the registry entry and pin the hand-off — **accepted**: app-shell takes no plugin-markdown dependency (package.json untouched), and pinning the renderer's output here would need one.
4. `origin/main` (`dded788ada`, after PR #11207) merged in — **accepted**: the merge-base is `dded788ada`, the net diff is the 11 files, none of #11207's.
5. `check:published-dist` started unlocked and stopped — **accepted** as a process note; the head's Build & E2E, Bundle Analysis and Test (dist pins) runs are green.
6. Worktree and probe servers cleaned up — housekeeping, noted.

`open_questions`: none declared; none found.
